title: Blisters
claims: Most blisters heal on their own within about a week and usually do not need a GP appointment.
NHS advises keeping a blister clean, covering it with a soft plaster or padded dressing, and not bursting it yourself.
Blisters are mostly caused by friction, burns or skin reactions, and well-fitting shoes help prevent friction blisters on the feet.
Cover blisters with a soft plaster or padded dressing and do not burst a blister yourself.
